NBA DRAFT.
BUILD YOUR DYNASTY.

5 rounds for the starting five + 5 bench picks. Each one is a pack of 3 random players at the position you need, including legends who have already retired. Balance rating against chemistry: playing on the same team right now is the strongest link, a shared past is a bit weaker — former teammates, same college, same country or same division. Money is real too: 2026-27 NBA salaries, a $165.0M salary cap, a luxury tax line and both aprons — the draft is hard-capped at the 2nd apron ($221.7M).
